question: Does a creature with ravenous enter the battlefield first and only then get its counters?

expected.shortAnswer: No: it gets its counters as it enters, so abilities that look at power or toughness on entering see them.
expected.answer: A creature with ravenous gets its counters as it enters the battlefield. It doesn't enter the battlefield first and then get its counters. Any triggered ability that looks for a creature with a certain power or toughness entering the battlefield will see the counters when it checks to see if it should trigger.
